payload.text: Next pass (pplr-vc, 2026-11-04): README's three points from dc's review of 27709bc, lines as at ca0e959. README:126 'macOS login secrets stay in the Keychain' becomes 'normally stay': on macOS read_stored falls back to .credentials.json (auth.rs:95-121). README:126 'including symlink aliases' becomes 'including symlink aliases of an existing directory': absolute() keeps a dangling link as a literal name, and existing() canonicalizes only a path that exists (config.rs:74, 225). README:118 'To move a registered profile' becomes 'To point a registered profile at another directory'. vc agreed all three wordings and offered to write them, so settle the writer with vc first.
